data.name: AlFarooqah
data.gender_notes: AlFarooqah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Al-Farooq is the name given to Prophet Ibrahim (AS) in the Quran, meaning the separator or the distinguisher between truth and falsehood. The name AlFarooqah carries the meaning “The Separator” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlFarooqah usually hope their child will grow to embody the separator and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the separation between good and evil, and the commitment to upholding truth and righteousness.
data.etymology: AlFarooqah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Separator.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlFarooqah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: الفرقہ
in_arabic.meaning: الفرقہ اسم ہے جو فرق کرنا، اختلاف کرنا، اور صحیح راستہ دکھانا
in_arabic.long_meaning: الفرقہ ایک ایسا نام ہے جو اللہ کی صفت سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے فرق کرنا، اختلاف کرنا، اور صحیح راستہ دکھانا۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر ہوا ہے اور اہل سنت کے لئے خاص اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ فرقہ حق کے قائم کرنے اور باطل کے خلاف لڑنے کی علامت ہے۔

in_urdu.name: الفرقہ
in_urdu.meaning: الفرقہ نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے فرق کرنا، صحیح راستہ دکھانا، اور باطل سے حق کو الگ کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: الفرقہ ایک ایسا نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے فرق کرنا، صحیح راستہ دکھانا، اور باطل سے حق کو الگ کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر اہل سنت کے لئے، کیونکہ یہ فرقہ حق کے قائم کرنے اور باطل کے خلاف لڑنے کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अलफ़रूक़ाह
in_hindi.meaning: अलफ़रूक़ाह नाम है जिसका अर्थ है भेद करना, सही रास्ता दिखाना और असत्य से सत्य को अलग करना

in_english.name: AlFarooqah
in_english.meaning: AlFarooqah means distinguisher, one who separates right from wrong, truth from falsehood
in_english.long_meaning: AlFarooqah is a name derived from Arabic roots, signifying one who distinguishes, separates, or discriminates between right and wrong, truth and falsehood. This name holds significant importance in Islamic tradition, particularly among Sunni Muslims, as it symbolizes the establishment of truth and the struggle against falsehood. The term 'Farooq' is also an attribute of Allah, emphasizing the divine quality of discernment.

data.cultural_impact: Al-Farooq is an epithet that was given to the Prophet Ibrahim (AS) in the Quran due to his unyielding commitment to truth and separation of the righteous from the wicked, even in his hometown of Ur. This name holds a significant place in Islamic culture and history, as it represents the courage and resilience of a prophet who stood up against societal norms that were contrary to the will of God. Al-Farooq's story serves as a reminder that standing up for truth and righteousness, even in the face of adversity, is a crucial aspect of Islamic values and identity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Al-Farooq holds immense spiritual significance for Muslims as it represents the distinction between truth and falsehood in one's spiritual journey. We are called upon to emulate the qualities of Al-Farooq by distinguishing between the truth that comes from God and the falsehood that comes from Satan and Our own self. By actively seeking and following the truth, Muslims can purify their hearts and souls, drawing closer to God, and ultimately achieving spiritual enlightenment. Moreover, the name Al-Farooq serves as an encouragement for Muslims to separate themselves from the wicked and evil influences in their lives, just as Prophet Ibrahim separated himself from his unjust society. Thus, Al-Farooq's name serves as a beacon of hope and guidance for Muslims striving to live a life pleasing to God.
